# LLM & Agent Authoring Guide (`three-live` & `xr-live`)

This guide is designed for **LLMs, coding assistants, and autonomous agents**
generating 3D and Spatial Computing (AR/VR/XR) code with `<three-live>` and
`<xr-live>`.

- **Repository Agent Instructions:** [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)
- **Installable Agent Skills:**
  - [`skills/three-live-authoring/SKILL.md`](../skills/three-live-authoring/SKILL.md) (building 3D/XR scenes and apps)
  - [`skills/xr-live-plugin-dev/SKILL.md`](../skills/xr-live-plugin-dev/SKILL.md) (contributing cross-platform traits and plugins)
- **Single-File Context Feeds:** [`/llms.txt`](../llms.txt) (concise index) and [`/llms-full.txt`](../llms-full.txt) (complete reference)

You can copy the **System Prompt Snippet** below directly into any LLM prompt or
agent skill to guarantee valid, zero-hallucination output.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Copy-Paste System Prompt Snippet for LLMs

```markdown
You are authoring 3D and Spatial Computing scenes using Google's `three-live` and `xr-live` web components.

### 1. Choose the Right Component & Bundle
- Use `<three-live>` (`three-live.min.js` or `three-live-full.min.js`) for 3D product viewers, procedural Three.js scenes, `KHR_interactivity` behavior graphs, PBR Next materials, and 1-tap mobile AR handoff (Quick Look / Scene Viewer / WebXR).
- Use `<xr-live>` (`xr-live.min.js` or `xr-live-full.min.js`) when the scene requires interactive 6DoF WebXR, declarative spatial traits (`userData.xr`), spatial HTML cards (`<div slot="spatial">`), depth occlusion & physics (`xr-depth`), 25-joint hand tracking (`xr-hands`), any of the 15 spatial plugins (`head-follow`, `manipulation-handles`, `world-understanding`, `gemini-live`, `spatial-paint`, `depth-particles`, `splat-loader`, `spatial-measure`, `magnetic-snap`, `gaze-dwell`, `exploded-view`, `persistent-anchors`, `spatial-locomotion`, `shared-room`, `spatial-audio`), or any of the 6 `xr-live-sim` simulation plugins (`character-controller`, `steering-agents`, `rigid-body`, `hit-zones`, `objectives`, `synth-audio`; available in `xr-live-sim.min.js` and `xr-live-full.min.js`).

### 2. Procedural `<script type="text/three">` Rules
- Inside `<script type="text/three">`, the globals `THREE` and `scene` (a `THREE.Scene` instance) are pre-defined.
- ALWAYS add the `allow-client-scripts` attribute to any `<three-live>` or `<xr-live>` element that contains an inline `<script type="text/three">`; without it the script is refused and nothing renders.
- Add all meshes, groups, and lights directly to `scene.add(...)`, and give interactive meshes a unique `mesh.name = '...'`.
- Attach canonical spatial traits via `mesh.userData.xr = { ... }`:
  - `grab`: `'1-hand' | '2-hand' | true`
  - `scale`: `{ min: 0.1, max: 5.0 } | true`
  - `billboard`: `'capsule' | 'cylindrical' | 'spherical' | true`
  - `follow`: `'head' | 'hand-left' | 'hand-right'` or `{ mode: 'head', lazy: true, distance: 1.2, deadzoneDeg: 15, stiffness: 6, height: -0.1, faceUser: true }`
  - `anchor`: `'floor' | 'wall' | 'ceiling' | 'table' | 'horizontal' | 'vertical'` or `{ target: 'table', id: 'part-1', persist: true }`
  - `physics` / `rigidBody`: `'dynamic' | 'static' | 'kinematic' | true` or `{ body: 'dynamic' | 'static' | 'kinematic', shape: 'auto' | 'box' | 'sphere' | 'cylinder', mass: 1, restitution: 0.35, friction: 0.5, linearDamping: 0.05, angularDamping: 0.1, gravityScale: 1, velocity: [0, 0, 0], angularVelocity: [0, 0, 0], lockRotation: false }`
  - `joint`: `'hinge' | 'slider' | 'spring' | 'ball' | true` or `{ type: 'hinge' | 'slider' | 'spring' | 'ball', target: 'nodeName' | 'world', anchor: [0, 0, 0], axis: 'x' | 'y' | 'z' | [0, 1, 0], limits: [-45, 90], stiffness: 40, damping: 4, restLength: 0.5, motorSpeed: 0, motorMaxForce: 10 }`
  - `orbit`: `{ target: [x, y, z] | 'nodeName', radius: 0.5, speed: 0.8, height: 0, faceCenter: true }`
  - `handles`: `{ rotateAxis: 'y' | 'none', minScale: 0.2, maxScale: 3.0 } | true`
  - `dimensions`: `{ unit: 'auto' | 'm' | 'cm' | 'mm' | 'in' | 'ft-in', axes: ['x', 'y', 'z'], color: '#38bdf8', showOnSelect: false } | true`
  - `snapTo`: `{ grid: 0.05, angleDeg: 15, surface: 'floor' | 'wall' | 'ceiling' | 'any' | 'none', socketTag: 'dock', radius: 0.15 } | true`
  - `snapSocket`: `'dock'` or `{ tag: 'dock', radius: 0.15, alignRotation: true, highlightColor: '#22c55e' }`
  - `gaze`: `{ dwellMs: 1200, action: 'select' | 'ask', repeat: false } | true`
  - `explode`: `{ direction: [0, 1, 0], distance: 0.35, layer: 1, leaderLine: true } | boolean`
  - `navigable`: `true | 'walkable' | 'blocked'`
  - `sync`: `boolean` (multi-user `shared-room` transform sync; defaults to `true` on grabbable nodes)
  - `particles`: `{ preset: 'rain' | 'snow' | 'sparks' | 'confetti', count: 400, area: [2, 2, 2], speed: 1.0 }`
  - `holdToAsk`: `{ prompt: 'What is this?', holdMs: 600 } | true`
  - `worldUnderstanding`: `{ planes: true, meshes: false, reticle: true }`
  - `splatUrl`: `'https://.../capture.spz'` (or `.splat`)
  - `splat`: `{ url: 'https://.../capture.spz', shDegree: 3, maxSplats: 500000 }`
  - `bloom`: `{ strength: 1.2, threshold: 0.8, radius: 0.5 } | boolean | number`
  - `outline`: `{ color: '#38bdf8', thickness: 0.03 } | boolean | string`
  - `ik`: `{ root: 'RootNode', mid: 'MidNode', effector: 'EffectorNode', target: 'TargetNodeName' | [x, y, z], pole: 'PoleNodeName' | [x, y, z], solver: 'two-bone' | 'fabrik', iterations: 10, tolerance: 0.001, weight: 1 }`
  - `lod`: `true` or `[0, 5, 12]` or `{ distances: [0, 5, 12], ratios: [1.0, 0.4, 0.15], cullDistance: 30, hysteresis: 0.05 }` (also `new THREE.LOD()` with `.addLevel(obj, distance)`)
  - `text`: `{ text: '3D Label', size: 0.2, depth: 0.04, bevelEnabled: true }`
  - `audioEmitter` / `audio`: `'hum'` or `{ preset: 'hum' | 'reactor' | 'wind' | 'beacon' | 'geiger' | 'chimeLoop' | 'machinery' | 'water' | 'confirm', src: 'https://.../sound.mp3', volume: 0.7, loop: true, autoplay: true, playOnSelect: false, distanceModel: 'inverse' | 'linear' | 'exponential', refDistance: 1.0, maxDistance: 20.0, rolloffFactor: 1.0, coneInnerAngle: 360, coneOuterAngle: 360, coneOuterGain: 0, pitchHz: 440 }`
  - `character`: `true` or `{ mode: 'third-person' | 'first-person' | 'top-down' | 'fixed-camera', speed: 4, jumpVelocity: 5.5, gravity: 15, radius: 0.35, height: 1.7, cameraDistance: 3.5, cameraHeight: 1.6 }`
  - `agent`: `'patrol'` or `{ behavior: 'patrol' | 'chase' | 'flee' | 'follow' | 'wander', speed: 2.5, waypoints: [[x, y, z], ...], loop: true, sightDistance: 8, sightAngleDeg: 110, reachDistance: 0.6, target: 'character' | 'nodeName', alertBehavior: 'chase' }`
  - `integrity`: `100` or `{ max: 100, current: 100, group: 'hazard' | 'player' | 'prop', scoreValue: 25, removeOnDeplete: true, hitCooldownMs: 120, contactAmount: 25 }`
  - `zone`: `{ shape: 'box' | 'sphere' | 'cylinder', size: [2, 2, 2], radius: 1.5, height: 2, triggerGroup: 'player', action: 'checkpoint' | 'hazard' | 'complete' | 'fail' | 'event', ratePerSec: 20, once: false, color: '#22c55e' }`
  - `spawner`: `{ template: 'BotNode', intervalSec: 3, maxActive: 5, maxTotal: 15, radius: 1.5, autoStart: true }`
  - `objective`: `'Inspect valve'` or `{ id: 'valve-1', label: 'Inspect valve', type: 'reach' | 'clear' | 'collect' | 'activate' | 'hold', points: 50, order: 1, required: true, holdSec: 1.5, reachRadius: 1.2 }`
  - `audioCues`: `{ onHit: 'thud', onDeplete: 'buzz', onCollect: 'chime', onObjective: 'beep', onJump: 'whoosh', onScenarioPass: 'sweep', onScenarioFail: 'alarm', pitchHz: 440, gain: 0.7 }`
- Attach declarative `KHR_interactivity` behaviors via `mesh.userData.interactivity = { onSelect: [...], onHoverIn: [...], onStart: [...] }` using actions `toggleTransform`, `interpolate`, `setProperty`, `toggleVisibility`, `cycleMaterialColor`, `playAnimation`, `stopAnimation`, or `sendEvent`.
- NEVER use `GLTFLoader`, `OBJLoader`, `TextureLoader`, `EffectComposer`, `ShaderMaterial`, `RawShaderMaterial`, or `requestAnimationFrame` inside `<script type="text/three">`.
- NEVER create a `THREE.WebGLRenderer` or attach DOM canvas elements inside `<script type="text/three">`.
- Respect strict scene quotas: max 1,000 meshes, 100,000 vertices, 300,000 indices, 16 textures, 3-second execution timeout.

### 3. Allowed `THREE.*` Constructors inside `<script type="text/three">`
- Math & IK: `Vector2`, `Vector3`, `Vector4`, `Euler`, `Quaternion`, `Matrix3`, `Matrix4`, `Color`, `MathUtils`, `Clock`, `IKSolver` (`solveTwoBone`, `solveFABRIK`)
- Geometries & CAD: `BoxGeometry`, `PlaneGeometry`, `SphereGeometry`, `CylinderGeometry`, `ConeGeometry`, `TorusGeometry`, `TorusKnotGeometry`, `LatheGeometry`, `TubeGeometry`, `Shape`, `Path`, `ShapeGeometry`, `ExtrudeGeometry`, `TextGeometry`, `CSG` (`union`, `subtract`, `intersect`), `BufferGeometry`, `BufferAttribute`
- Materials: `MeshStandardMaterial`, `MeshBasicMaterial`, `MeshLambertMaterial`, `MeshPhongMaterial`, `MeshPhysicalMaterial` (plus `mesh.userData.variants` for `KHR_materials_variants`)
- Material presets (`procedural` plugin; built into the CLI/MCP compiler): spread `THREE.ProceduralTexture.wood({ color: 0x8b5a2b, scale: 10, seed: 3 })` (also `marble`, `brick`, `concrete`, `brushedMetal`, `rust`, `leather`, `fabric`, `carbonFiber`, `checkerboard`, `grid`) into `MeshStandardMaterial` for seamless, deterministic `map` + `normalMap` + roughness/metalness textures, or set `mesh.userData.xr = { material: 'marble' }` to bake a preset tinted by the material color (when non-white). Each preset adds up to 3 textures against the 16-texture scene quota: identical options return shared textures, and `normalStrength: 0` skips the normal map. Optional AI texture: add `prompt` (and `size: 256 | 512`, `seed`) to the object form, e.g. `mesh.userData.xr = { material: { preset: 'brick', prompt: 'weathered temple stone with moss' } }`. The compiler never generates images: the albedo comes from a texture pack the host supplies, and until an entry exists the preset is shown. Always keep a `preset` as the fallback.
- Scene Graph, LOD & Instancing: `Scene`, `Group`, `Mesh`, `LOD` (`addLevel`, `getObjectForDistance`), `InstancedMesh` (`setMatrixAt`, `getMatrixAt`, `setColorAt`, `getColorAt`, `count`), `Object3D` (`position`, `rotation`, `scale`, `matrix`, `add`, `remove`, `traverse`)
- Lights & Cameras: `AmbientLight`, `DirectionalLight`, `PointLight`, `Camera`, `PerspectiveCamera`
```

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## DO vs. DO NOT Cheat Sheet

| DO (Supported & Fast) | DO NOT (Unsupported / Anti-Pattern) |
| :------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | :------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Use `new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color, metalness, roughness })` | Do NOT use `THREE.ShaderMaterial` or custom GLSL strings in scripts |
| Add objects to the global `scene` (`scene.add(mesh)`) | Do NOT instantiate `new THREE.WebGLRenderer()` or call `renderer.render()` |
| Set `mesh.userData.xr = { grab: '2-hand', handles: { rotateAxis: 'y' } }` | Do NOT write manual WebXR session setup (`navigator.xr.requestSession`) |
| Set `mesh.userData.interactivity = { onSelect: [{ action: 'toggleTransform', ... }] }` | Do NOT try to access `window` or `document` inside sandboxed `<script type="text/three">` |
| Use `<div slot="spatial" data-position="x y z" data-xr-traits="grab billboard">` for spatial HTML UI | Do NOT use `new THREE.GLTFLoader().load(...)` inside procedural scripts (use `src="..."` or `<xr-anchor src="...">`) |

### Permissive Fallback Shims & Diagnostic Warnings (JS & Rust Compiler)

While LLMs should prefer the canonical APIs above for highest fidelity, both the
JavaScript authoring runtime (`three-author`) and the native Rust compiler
(`compiler/`) include **permissive fallback shims** so common LLM-generated
Three.js assumptions never crash or abort a 3D/XR scene:

-   **Shaders (`ShaderMaterial`, `RawShaderMaterial`):** Gracefully downgraded
    to `MeshStandardMaterial`, preserving `uniforms.color.value` /
    `params.color` and opacity so the mesh renders in 3D and XR.
-   **Polyhedra & Extended Geometries (`IcosahedronGeometry`,
    `OctahedronGeometry`, `DodecahedronGeometry`, `TetrahedronGeometry`,
    `CapsuleGeometry`, `RingGeometry`, `CircleGeometry`):** Mapped to
    parameter-compatible `SphereGeometry` or `CylinderGeometry` primitives.
-   **Lights (`SpotLight`, `HemisphereLight`, `RectAreaLight`):** Mapped to
    `PointLight` or `AmbientLight`.
-   **Unknown / Hallucinated Classes:** Any unknown `THREE.*` class resolves to
    a safe recursive no-op proxy, and `new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat)` automatically
    substitutes a fallback `BoxGeometry` / `MeshStandardMaterial` if passed a
    non-geometry or non-material proxy.
-   **Browser Boilerplate (`requestAnimationFrame`, `window`, `document`):**
    Safely shimmed in headless/Worker/Rust sandboxes so trailing render loops
    (`requestAnimationFrame(animate)`) or `window.innerWidth /
    window.innerHeight` checks do not throw `ReferenceError`.
-   **Diagnostic Warnings:** Every degraded feature logs a deduplicated
    `console.warn` and is recorded in `THREE.getAuthorWarnings()` (reset via
    `THREE.clearAuthorWarnings()`).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Canonical Few-Shot Templates

### Template 1: Interactive 3D Scene with `KHR_interactivity` & AR Handoff (`<three-live>`)

```html
<script type="module" src="/dist/three-live-full.min.js"></script>

<three-live allow-client-scripts camera-controls ar auto-rotate shadow-intensity="0.7" style="width: 100%; height: 500px; display: block;">
  <script type="text/three">
    const base = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.6, 0.7, 0.2, 32),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x1e293b, metalness: 0.8, roughness: 0.2 })
    );
    base.name = 'pedestal';
    scene.add(base);

    const crystal = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.35, 32, 32),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x38bdf8, metalness: 0.1, roughness: 0.1 })
    );
    crystal.name = 'crystal';
    crystal.position.set(0, 0.55, 0);
    crystal.userData.interactivity = {
      onSelect: [
        { action: 'toggleTransform', property: 'translation', from: [0, 0.55, 0], to: [0, 0.85, 0], duration: 0.35 },
        { action: 'cycleMaterialColor', colors: [[0.22, 0.74, 0.97, 1], [0.66, 0.33, 0.97, 1]], duration: 0.25 }
      ]
    };
    scene.add(crystal);

    const light = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 2.0);
    light.position.set(2, 4, 3);
    scene.add(light);
  </script>
</three-live>
```

### Template 2: Full Spatial Computing Scene with Extended XR Traits (`<xr-live>`)

```html
<script type="module" src="/dist/xr-live-full.min.js"></script>

<xr-live
  allow-client-scripts
  xr-mode="ar"
  xr-depth="occlusion-physics"
  xr-hands="gestures"
  xr-simulator="living-room"
  world-understanding="planes reticle"
  spatial-paint="#38bdf8"
  camera-controls
  style="width: 100%; height: 600px; display: block;">

  <!-- Interactive procedural 3D objects with canonical userData.xr traits -->
  <script type="text/three">
    const sculpture = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TorusKnotGeometry(0.18, 0.06, 64, 16),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xa855f7, metalness: 0.6, roughness: 0.25 })
    );
    sculpture.name = 'sculpture';
    sculpture.position.set(0, 1.1, -1.0);
    sculpture.userData.xr = {
      grab: '2-hand',
      handles: { rotateAxis: 'y', minScale: 0.3, maxScale: 3.0 },
      holdToAsk: { prompt: 'What is this sculpture?', holdMs: 600 }
    };
    scene.add(sculpture);

    const satellite = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.05, 24, 24),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x38bdf8 })
    );
    satellite.name = 'satellite';
    satellite.userData.xr = {
      orbit: { target: 'sculpture', radius: 0.38, speed: 1.0, faceCenter: true }
    };
    scene.add(satellite);
  </script>

  <!-- Live HTML spatial card floating next to the 3D object -->
  <div slot="spatial" data-position="0.45 1.1 -1.0" data-xr-traits="grab billboard">
    <div style="padding: 14px; background: #111827; color: #f9fafb; border-radius: 12px; width: 220px;">
      <h4>Spatial Control Panel</h4>
      <p>Drag corner handles to scale, or pinch in empty space to paint in 3D.</p>
      <button onclick="console.log('Clicked in 3D space!')">Inspect Details</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</xr-live>
```

### Template 3: Collaborative CAD Studio (`exploded-view` + `spatial-measure` + `magnetic-snap` + `shared-room`)

```html
<script type="module" src="/dist/xr-live-full.min.js"></script>

<xr-live
  allow-client-scripts
  spatial-measure="all"
  measure-unit="cm"
  magnetic-snap="all"
  gaze-dwell="auto"
  explode="0.4"
  explode-mode="axial-y"
  section-plane="x:0"
  persistent-anchors="cad-review"
  persist-url-hash
  locomotion="teleport snap-turn"
  shared-room="cad-review-room"
  peer-name="Reviewer"
  peer-color="#38bdf8"
  camera-controls
  style="width: 100%; height: 600px; display: block;">
  <script type="text/three">
    const deck = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.4, 1.4, 0.04, 48),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x0f172a, roughness: 0.85 })
    );
    deck.name = 'walkable-deck';
    deck.position.set(0, -0.45, -1.2);
    deck.userData.xr = { navigable: 'walkable', explode: false, sync: false };
    scene.add(deck);

    const chassis = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.28, 0.32, 0.16, 36),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x334155, metalness: 0.75, roughness: 0.25 })
    );
    chassis.name = 'turbine-chassis';
    chassis.position.set(0, 0.75, -1.2);
    chassis.userData.xr = {
      dimensions: { unit: 'cm', axes: ['x', 'y', 'z'] },
      snapSocket: { tag: 'rotor-bay', radius: 0.18, highlightColor: '#22c55e' },
      explode: false
    };
    scene.add(chassis);

    const shroud = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.24, 0.26, 0.22, 36),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x38bdf8, metalness: 0.65, roughness: 0.2 })
    );
    shroud.name = 'upper-shroud';
    shroud.position.set(0, 0.96, -1.2);
    shroud.userData.xr = {
      grab: '1-hand',
      snapTo: { socketTag: 'rotor-bay', radius: 0.18, angleDeg: 15 },
      explode: { direction: [0, 1, 0], distance: 0.32, layer: 2, leaderLine: true },
      gaze: { dwellMs: 1000, action: 'select' },
      anchor: { id: 'upper-shroud', persist: true },
      sync: true
    };
    scene.add(shroud);

    const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 2.2);
    key.position.set(2, 4, 3);
    scene.add(key);
    scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.6));
  </script>
</xr-live>
```

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 5. Closed-Loop AI Agent Verification (`three-live-cli` & MCP Server)

AI coding agents can validate, visually inspect, and simulate
`<script type="text/three">` scenes, `.html` host documents, and `.glb` files in
under `50 ms` without launching a headless browser—either via CLI subcommands or
via the built-in **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** stdio server
(`three-live-cli mcp`):

```bash
# Register the MCP stdio server in Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, or Windsurf:
claude mcp add three-live -- npx -y -p three-live three-live-cli mcp
```

Or add to `.mcp.json` / `claude_desktop_config.json` / `.cursor/mcp.json`:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "three-live": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "-p", "three-live", "three-live-cli", "mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

The MCP server exposes 8 tools (`three_live_validate`, `three_live_render`,
`three_live_convert`, `three_live_sim`, `three_live_link`, `three_live_gym_reset`,
`three_live_gym_step`, `three_live_gym_close`), 1 resource
(`three-live://docs/authoring-guide`), and 2 prompts (`author_three_live_scene`,
`build_from_reference`). Note that `three_live_render` returns MCP `image/png`
content blocks directly into multimodal LLM context so agents can visually
self-correct camera framing, overlap, and lighting.

### Reference-Driven Authoring (`reference`)

When the user supplies a photo, product shot, design mockup, sketch, or CAD
blueprint, pass it to `three_live_render` as `reference` (a local PNG/JPEG path
or a `data:image/...;base64,` URI; remote URLs are never fetched):

```json
{ "name": "three_live_render",
  "arguments": { "inputPath": "lamp.js", "reference": "lamp_photo.jpg", "view": "camera" } }
```

-   The scene renders at the reference's aspect ratio into a **REFERENCE |
    RENDER | OVERLAY | SILHOUETTE DIFF** sheet. On plain or transparent
    backgrounds the OVERLAY is auto-aligned for position and scale, and the DIFF
    panel marks render-only areas orange and reference-only areas cyan.
-   The JSON `reference` block reports `silhouetteIou` (scale/translation
    invariant), `referenceAspect` / `renderAspect` / `aspectError`,
    `silhouetteReliable`, and `guidance`. Aim for `silhouetteIou >= 0.85` and
    `|aspectError| < 0.05` when `silhouetteReliable` is true; for busy photo
    backgrounds or line-art sketches, judge by the OVERLAY panel.
-   Use `view: "front" | "right" | "top"` for orthographic blueprints and
    `view: "camera"` (default) for perspective photos, tuning `cameraPosition`,
    `cameraTarget`, and `cameraFov` to match the photo's perspective.
-   JPEG EXIF orientation is honored; PNG supports every color type, bit depth,
    transparency, and Adam7 interlacing.

You can also invoke the CLI directly from shell tools:

```bash
# 1. Structured JSON Diagnostics (TL100-TL402) + Spatial Frustum/Grounding/Lighting Linter
three-live-cli validate scene.js --json

# 2. 4-Up Quad Contact Sheet (Perspective + Front + Right + Top with 1m Grid & AABB Labels)
three-live-cli render scene.js -o preview.png --view=quad --grid --annotations

# 3. Multi-Frame Temporal Filmstrip or Animated GIF89a (`animate(t)` + KHR_interactivity Tweens)
three-live-cli render scene.js -o anim.png --frames=4 --duration=2.0 --trigger-select=crystal

# 4. Deterministic 60Hz Scenario & KHR_interactivity Simulation
three-live-cli sim scene.js --duration=5.0 \
  --actions='[{"at":0.2,"type":"select","target":"crystal"},{"at":0.5,"type":"moveCharacter","direction":[0,0,-1],"duration":1.5,"jump":true}]' \
  --json
```

### Agent Gym: Play a Scene Step by Step (`three_live_gym_reset` / `three_live_gym_step`)

`three_live_sim` runs a script you write up front. The gym lets an agent *play*
a scene instead: act, look at the result, and decide the next action. Use it to
check that a level is winnable, tune enemy speed or jump heights, or test
interactive scenes end to end.

"Gym" is the reinforcement-learning name for this kind of playable
environment, after OpenAI Gym (now Gymnasium): `reset` starts an episode, and
each `step` takes actions and returns an observation, a reward, and whether
the episode is done. No machine learning is involved; any agent (or script)
that can call a tool in a loop can use it.

```json
{ "name": "three_live_gym_reset",
  "arguments": { "inputPath": "level.js", "watch": ["Hero", "Coin"] } }
// -> { "sessionId": "gym-1", "tick": 0, "scenarioState": "running", "bodies": [...] }

{ "name": "three_live_gym_step",
  "arguments": { "sessionId": "gym-1", "ticks": 30,
                 "actions": [{ "type": "moveCharacter", "direction": [0, 0, -1], "jump": true }] } }
// -> { "tick": 30, "reward": 5, "events": ["objectiveComplete:Coin"],
//      "newObjectives": ["Coin"], "done": true, "scenarioState": "victory", ... }
```

-   Each step applies `actions` (same shapes as `three_live_sim`; `at` is a
    delay in seconds from the start of the step) and advances `ticks` 60 Hz
    ticks (default 30, max 600). `moveCharacter` lasts the whole step unless
    you pass `duration`.
-   Every observation lists `bodies` (position, rotation, scale, visible,
    grounded, health, destroyed; at most 64, use `watch` to choose), `score`,
    `reward` (score gained this step), and the `events`, `audioCues`, and
    `newObjectives` fired during the step.
-   `done` turns true on `victory` (all `required: true` objectives done),
    on `defeat` (the character is destroyed), or at the 120 s / 240-step limit.
    Further steps fail; call `three_live_gym_reset` again.
-   Pass `includeFrame: true` (with `view`, `width`, `height`) to get a PNG of
    the state after the step.
-   The reset observation lists the `events` and `audioCues` fired at `t = 0`
    (`onSpawn`, `onStart`, trait registrations).
-   Episodes are deterministic: the same actions always give the same
    observations. Steps on static scenes take well under a millisecond;
    scenes with `animate(t)` or `requestAnimationFrame` re-run their script
    once per step (tens of milliseconds for typical scenes). Close sessions you
    are done with (`three_live_gym_close`); beyond 16 the least recently used
    is evicted.

Without MCP, use `three-live-cli gym`. One command per step suits shell-tool
agents; the session file holds the scene and every step, and each call replays
it deterministically:

```bash
three-live-cli gym reset level.js --session ep.json --watch Hero,Coin
three-live-cli gym step --session ep.json --ticks 30 \
  --actions '[{"type":"moveCharacter","direction":[0,0,-1]}]' --frame step.png
```

For scripts and RL harnesses, `three-live-cli gym play level.js` prints the
`t = 0` observation, then reads one JSON step per stdin line
(`{"actions": [...], "ticks": 30, "frame": "f.png"}`) and prints one
observation (or `{"error": ...}`) per line, keeping state in memory.

### Diagnostic Code Summary (`TL100–TL402`)

| Code    | Category | Meaning & Fix                        |
| :------ | :------- | :----------------------------------- |
| `TL100` | Compiler | JavaScript syntax error, uncaught    |
:         :          : runtime exception, or sandbox quota  :
:         :          : violation (includes 1-based          :
:         :          : `line`/`column`).                    :
| `TL101` | Compiler | Unsupported material                 |
:         :          : (`ShaderMaterial`,                   :
:         :          : `RawShaderMaterial`) downgraded to   :
:         :          : `MeshStandardMaterial`.              :
| `TL102` | Compiler | Unsupported geometry                 |
:         :          : (`IcosahedronGeometry`,              :
:         :          : `OctahedronGeometry`,                :
:         :          : `DodecahedronGeometry`,              :
:         :          : `TetrahedronGeometry`,               :
:         :          : `TubeGeometry`,                      :
:         :          : `PolyhedronGeometry`) approximated   :
:         :          : as sphere/cylinder.                  :
| `TL103` | Compiler | Blocked network/loader API           |
:         :          : (`THREE.GLTFLoader`,                 :
:         :          : `TextureLoader`, `fetch`) inside     :
:         :          : sandbox; use `<three-live            :
:         :          : src="...">`.                         :
| `TL104` | Compiler | `requestAnimationFrame` used in      |
:         :          : static `.glb`/`.usdz` export; prefer :
:         :          : `userData.xr.orbit` or               :
:         :          : `userData.interactivity`.            :
| `TL105` | Compiler | Unknown `THREE.*` property           |
:         :          : intercepted by chaining proxy.       :
| `TL201` | Schema   | Unrecognized `userData.xr` or        |
:         :          : `userData.interactivity` key with    :
:         :          : Levenshtein typo suggestion (e.g.,   :
:         :          : `grabbable` -> `grab`, `onClick` ->  :
:         :          : `onSelect`).                         :
| `TL202` | Schema   | Out-of-range numeric trait clamped   |
:         :          : to valid domain (`dwellMs`,          :
:         :          : `bloom.strength`,                    :
:         :          : `outline.thickness`,                 :
:         :          : `splat.shDegree`).                   :
| `TL203` | Schema   | Unsafe URL or anchor ID rejected     |
:         :          : (`safeMediaUrl`, `isAllowedLiveUrl`, :
:         :          : `safeAnchorId`).                     :
| `TL204` | Schema   | Broken node reference                |
:         :          : (`orbit.target`, `joint.target`,     :
:         :          : `ik.root`/`mid`/`effector`/`target`, :
:         :          : `spawner.template`,                  :
:         :          : `interactivity.*.target`).           :
| `TL205` | Schema   | Unnamed interactive or spatial mesh  |
:         :          : (`mesh.name === ""`); assign a       :
:         :          : unique `mesh.name`.                  :
| `TL206` | Schema   | `userData.xr.material.prompt` is     |
:         :          : empty, longer than 500 characters    :
:         :          : (error), or has no `preset` fallback :
:         :          : (warning).                           :
| `TL301` | Spatial  | Empty scene (`meshCount == 0` or     |
:         :          : `vertexCount == 0`).                 :
| `TL302` | Spatial  | Camera position is enclosed inside a |
:         :          : mesh's world AABB.                   :
| `TL303` | Spatial  | Mesh is outside the camera frustum   |
:         :          : (or scenes fill `< 1%` / `> 95%` of  :
:         :          : the viewport).                       :
| `TL304` | Spatial  | Scene diagonal is microscopic (`<    |
:         :          : 0.01 m`) or gigantic (`> 200 m`,     :
:         :          : e.g. millimeter units).              :
| `TL305` | Spatial  | Metallic PBR materials (`metalness > |
:         :          : 0.5`) with no scene lights and no    :
:         :          : `environment`.                       :
| `TL306` | Spatial  | Two non-floor sibling meshes share   |
:         :          : `> 80%` AABB intersection volume     :
:         :          : (accidental duplicate placement).    :
| `TL307` | Spatial  | Scene or `character`/`physics:       |
:         :          : "dynamic"` mesh is floating          :
:         :          : (`min.y > 0.25 m`) or buried (`min.y :
:         :          : < -0.5 m`).                          :
| `TL401` | HTML     | `<three-live>` / `<xr-live>`         |
:         :          : contains `<script                    :
:         :          : type="text/three">` without          :
:         :          : `allow-client-scripts`.              :
| `TL402` | HTML     | `<xr-live>` spatial attributes/slots |
:         :          : (`xr-hands`, `gemini-live`,          :
:         :          : `plugins`, `slot="spatial"`) placed  :
:         :          : on `<three-live>`.                   :

# `<three-live>` & `<xr-live>` Complete Traits, Plugins & Events Reference

## 1. `<xr-live>` Host Attributes

`<xr-live>` inherits every `<three-live>` attribute (`src`, `ios-src`, `poster`, `scale`, `camera-orbit`, `camera-target`, `min-camera-orbit`, `max-camera-orbit`, `field-of-view`, `selected-mesh`, `camera-controls`, `ar`, `ar-modes`, `ar-scale`, `ar-placement`, `script-src`, `sandbox`, `allow-client-scripts`, `exposure`, `environment-image`, `skybox-image`, `shadow-intensity`, `shadow-softness`, `tone-mapping`, `autoplay`, `animation-name`, `auto-rotate`) and adds:

Attribute             | Values                                                                                         | Default     | Description
:-------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :---------- | :----------
`xr-mode`             | `'ar' \| 'vr' \| 'inline' \| 'auto'`                                                           | `'auto'`    | Target WebXR session mode.
`xr-depth`            | `'occlusion' \| 'occlusion-physics' \| 'mesh' \| 'none'`                                       | `'none'`    | Hardware depth occlusion and analytical heightfield physics collision.
`xr-hands`            | `'gestures' \| 'joints' \| 'pinch' \| 'none'`                                                  | `'none'`    | 25-joint `XRHand` tracking and gesture classification (`pinch`, `grab`, `point`, `palm-up`).
`xr-simulator`        | `'living-room' \| 'office' \| 'tabletop' \| 'none'`                                            | `'none'`    | Enables the desktop 6DoF keyboard/mouse simulator with room floor/table planes.
`xr-profile`          | `'quest3' \| 'android-xr' \| 'visionos' \| 'auto'`                                             | `'auto'`    | Target hardware profile hint.
`sound-feedback`      | boolean attribute                                                                              | `false`     | Plays procedural Web Audio earcons (`grab`, `release`, `bounce`, `hover`) on interaction.
`world-understanding` | `'' \| 'planes' \| 'planes reticle' \| 'false'`                                                | —           | Activates `xr-live-world-understanding` plane/mesh tracking and optional gaze reticle.
`spatial-paint`       | `'' \| '#rrggbb' \| 'false'`                                                                   | —           | Activates `xr-live-spatial-paint`; pinching in empty space extrudes Catmull-Rom 3D tube strokes.
`spatial-measure`     | `'' \| 'bounds' \| 'tape' \| 'all' \| 'none'`                                                  | —           | Activates `xr-live-spatial-measure` 3D dimension callouts and/or interactive AR tape measure.
`measure-unit`        | `'auto' \| 'm' \| 'cm' \| 'mm' \| 'in' \| 'ft-in'`                                             | `'auto'`    | Default display unit for `spatial-measure`.
`magnetic-snap`       | `'' \| 'grid' \| 'surface' \| 'sockets' \| 'all' \| 'none'`                                    | —           | Activates `xr-live-magnetic-snap` socket, grid, surface, and yaw snapping.
`snap-grid`           | `number` or `'gx gy gz'` (meters)                                                              | —           | Default Cartesian snap grid spacing in meters.
`snap-angle`          | `number` (`0..180` degrees)                                                                    | `0`         | Default rotational yaw snap increment in degrees.
`gaze-dwell`          | `'' \| 'auto' \| 'false' \| 'none'`                                                            | —           | Activates `xr-live-gaze-dwell` hands-free eye/head gaze reticle and radial dwell selection.
`dwell-time`          | `number` (`250..10000` ms)                                                                     | `1200`      | Default dwell duration in milliseconds for `gaze-dwell`.
`explode`             | `number` (`0..1`)                                                                              | `0`         | Normalized multi-part assembly explosion factor (`xr-live-exploded-view`).
`explode-mode`        | `'radial' \| 'axial-x' \| 'axial-y' \| 'axial-z' \| 'hierarchical'`                            | `'radial'`  | Automatic explosion vector strategy when parts omit `userData.xr.explode.direction`.
`explode-scale`       | `number`                                                                                       | `1.0`       | Multiplier applied to per-part explosion distances.
`section-plane`       | `'none' \| 'x:<d>' \| 'y:<d>' \| 'z:<d>' \| '-x:<d>' \| '-y:<d>' \| '-z:<d>' \| 'interactive'` | `'none'`    | Real-time GPU cross-section clipping plane in scene (model) space (`d` in meters; the cut follows the model through AR placement and turntable rotation) with optional draggable gizmo frame.
`persistent-anchors`  | `''` or `string` (namespace)                                                                   | —           | Activates `xr-live-persistent-anchors` cross-session transform persistence (`xr-live:anchors:<ns>`).
`persist-url-hash`    | boolean attribute                                                                              | `false`     | Encodes persisted node poses into `#xr-state=<base64url>` (`<= 8192` bytes) for link sharing.
`locomotion`          | `'' \| 'teleport' \| 'snap-turn' \| 'smooth' \| 'teleport snap-turn' \| 'none'`                | —           | Activates `xr-live-spatial-locomotion` parabolic teleportation, snap-turns, or smooth glide.
`snap-turn-deg`       | `number` (degrees)                                                                             | `30`        | Horizontal thumbstick snap-turn increment in degrees.
`comfort-vignette`    | boolean attribute                                                                              | `true`      | Shows a `120ms` peripheral FOV comfort vignette during teleports and snap-turns.
`shared-room`         | `'<room-id>'` or `'wss://...'`                                                                 | —           | Joins a multi-user room via `BroadcastChannel("xr-live:room:<id>")` or a `wss://` relay (`xr-live-shared-room`).
`shared-room-voice`   | boolean attribute                                                                              | `false`     | Opts in to voice **signaling** in `shared-room`: relays WebRTC offer/answer/ICE messages (`peerrtcsignal` event, `broadcastRtcSignal()`) and computes per-peer `voiceGain` (`computeSpatialVoiceGain`). Your app owns `getUserMedia`, `RTCPeerConnection`, and audio playback.
`peer-name`           | `string` (max `32` chars)                                                                      | —           | Local peer display name broadcast in `shared-room`.
`peer-color`          | `'#rrggbb'`                                                                                    | `'#38bdf8'` | Local peer 3D visor & laser ray tint color in `shared-room`.
`bloom`               | `boolean \| string`                                                                            | —           | Enables HDR emissive bloom (`bloom`, `bloom="1.4"`, or `bloom="strength:1.2 threshold:0.75 radius:0.5"`).
`outline`             | `boolean \| string`                                                                            | —           | Enables silhouette outlines on `selected-mesh` or nodes with `userData.xr.outline` (`outline="#38bdf8 0.03"`).
`variant-name`        | `string`                                                                                       | —           | Selects active `KHR_materials_variants` colorway name (`viewer.variantName` / `viewer.availableVariants`).
`webmcp`              | boolean attribute                                                                              | `false`     | Registers `inspect_xr_scene`, `place_xr_object_at_gaze`, and `capture_xr_view` on `navigator.modelContext`.
`webmcp-allow-depth`  | boolean attribute                                                                              | `false`     | Opt-in gate allowing `capture_xr_view` to include the 8×8 metric `depthGridMeters` array.
`webmcp-omit-pose`    | boolean attribute                                                                              | `false`     | When present, `inspect_xr_scene` omits `headPosition` entirely.

## 3. Declarative `KHR_interactivity` Authoring (`userData.interactivity`)

Any mesh or group inside `<script type="text/three">` can declare interactive state machines compiled into standard Khronos `KHR_interactivity` graphs (`three-live/src/interactivity-compiler.ts`):

- **Triggers:**
  - `onSelect`: Fired when clicked/tapped or pinched in XR (`pointer/onSelect`).
  - `onHoverIn` / `onHoverOut`: Fired on pointer/ray hover enter and exit.
  - `onStart`: Fired automatically when the scene loads (`event/onStart`).
  - `onReceive`: `{ [eventName: string]: Action | Action[] }` — reacts to custom events sent by `sendEvent`.
- **Actions (single object or array executed in sequence):**
  - `{ action: 'toggleTransform', property: 'translation' | 'rotation' | 'scale', to: number[], from?: number[], duration?: number }`
  - `{ action: 'interpolate', target?: string, property: 'translation' | 'rotation' | 'scale' | 'baseColorFactor' | 'metallicFactor' | 'roughnessFactor' | 'emissiveFactor', to: number | number[], duration?: number }`
  - `{ action: 'setProperty', target?: string, property: string, value: any }`
  - `{ action: 'toggleVisibility', target?: string }`
  - `{ action: 'cycleMaterialColor', colors: Array<[number, number, number, number?]>, duration?: number }`
  - `{ action: 'playAnimation', animation?: number }` / `{ action: 'stopAnimation' }`
  - `{ action: 'sendEvent', event: string, values?: Record<string, any> }`

---

## 4. Programmatic Plugin Controllers (`xr-live/spatial`)

When importing from `xr-live/spatial` (or using `xr-live-spatial.min.js` /
`xr-live-full.min.js`):

- **Gemini Live (`gemini-live.ts`):**

    ```ts
    import { connectGeminiLive } from 'xr-live/spatial';

    const live = connectGeminiLive(xrElement, {
      url: 'wss://your-backend.example.com/gemini-live', // wss:// required (or ws://localhost)
      model: 'models/gemini-2.0-flash-exp',
      systemInstruction: 'You are a spatial assistant.',
      frameIntervalMs: 1000,   // clamped to [250, 60000] ms
      streamAudio: true,       // streams 16 kHz PCM mic chunks
      playAudio: true,         // plays streamed 24 kHz PCM model audio
      speakReplies: false,     // SpeechSynthesis fallback
      detectObjects: true,     // auto-registers report_objects tool -> xr-object-detected events
    });
    ```
- **Spatial Paint (`spatial-paint.ts`):**

    ```ts
    import { getSpatialPaintController } from 'xr-live/spatial';

    const paint = getSpatialPaintController(xrElement);
    paint.color = [0.22, 0.74, 0.97, 1.0];
    paint.radius = 0.008;
    paint.undo(xrElement.viewer);
    paint.clear(xrElement.viewer);
    ```
- **World Understanding (`world-understanding.ts`):**

    ```ts
    import { detectObjects, parseDetections, XRTapeMeasure } from 'xr-live/spatial';

    const detections = parseDetections('[{"label":"chair","box":[200,300,800,700]}]');
    const located3D = detectObjects(xrElement, detections);
    ```
-   **Spatial Measure, Exploded View, Persistent Anchors, Locomotion & Shared
    Room:**

    ```ts
    import {
      getSpatialMeasureController,
      getMagneticSnapController,
      getGazeDwellController,
      getExplodedViewController,
      getPersistentAnchorsController,
      getSpatialLocomotionController,
      getSharedRoomController,
    } from 'xr-live/spatial';

    xrElement.setExplode(0.65);                     // Smoothly animate exploded-view [0..1]
    xrElement.clearMeasurements();                  // Clear locked 3D tape-measure segments
    const token = xrElement.exportAnchorState();    // Base64url layout snapshot (<= 8 KB)
    xrElement.importAnchorState(token);             // Restore layout snapshot programmatically
    xrElement.teleportTo([0, 0, -1.5]);             // Teleport viewer rig + emit xrteleport
    const peers = xrElement.getSharedPeers();       // Active RemotePeerState[] in shared-room
    ```

---

## 5. DOM Events Summary

Event Name                         | Dispatched By                | `event.detail` Payload
:--------------------------------- | :--------------------------- | :---------------------
`load`                             | `<three-live>` / `<xr-live>` | `{ model: GLBData }`
`error`                            | `<three-live>` / `<xr-live>` | `{ error: Error }`
`meshclick`                        | `<three-live>` / `<xr-live>` | `{ meshName, hitPoint, normal, distance }`
`camera-change`                    | `<three-live>` / `<xr-live>` | `{ theta, phi, distance }`
`ar-status`                        | `<three-live>` / `<xr-live>` | `{ status: 'session-started' \| 'not-presenting' \| 'failed', error? }`
`interactivityEvent`               | `KHR_interactivity` VM       | `{ id: string, values: Record<string, any> }`
`xr-select-start` / `move` / `end` | `XRInputManager`             | `{ hand: 'left' \| 'right' \| 'screen', pivotPosition, quaternion, rayOrigin, rayDirection, hit }`
`xr-handles-change`                | `manipulation-handles`       | `{ mesh, scale: number, yawDeg: number }`
`xr-object-detected`               | `world-understanding`        | `{ label: string, position: [number, number, number], distanceMeters: number, source: 'plane' \| 'depth' \| 'fallback' }`
`xr-transcription`                 | `gemini-live`                | `{ speaker: 'user' \| 'model', text: string, isFinal: boolean }`
`xr-hold-to-ask-listening`         | `gemini-live`                | `{ mesh: string }`
`xr-hold-to-ask`                   | `gemini-live`                | `{ mesh: string, transcript: string, prompt: string }`
`xr-gemini-interrupted`            | `gemini-live`                | `{}`
`xr-paint-stroke`                  | `spatial-paint`              | `{ index: number, points: number, lengthMeters: number }`
`measurecomplete`                  | `spatial-measure`            | `{ start: [x,y,z], end: [x,y,z], distanceMeters: number, formatted: string }`
`xrsnap`                           | `magnetic-snap`              | `{ node, socket, position: [x,y,z], quaternion: [x,y,z,w], mode: 'socket' \| 'grid' \| 'surface' \| 'angle' }`
`xrunsnap`                         | `magnetic-snap`              | `{ node, socket }`
`gazeenter` / `gazeleave`          | `gaze-dwell`                 | `{ node, point: [x,y,z] }` / `{ node }`
`gazedwell`                        | `gaze-dwell`                 | `{ node, point: [x,y,z], action: 'select' \| 'ask' }`
`explodechange`                    | `exploded-view`              | `{ factor: number, source: 'attribute' \| 'gesture' \| 'api' \| 'peer' }`
`anchorsrestored`                  | `persistent-anchors`         | `{ count: number, source: 'xr-anchor' \| 'storage' \| 'url-hash' }`
`xrteleport`                       | `spatial-locomotion`         | `{ from: [x,y,z], to: [x,y,z], yawDeg: number }`
`peerjoin` / `peerleave`           | `shared-room`                | `{ peerId: string, name: string, color: string }`
`peergrabconflict`                 | `shared-room`                | `{ peerId: string, nodeId: string }`
`peersync`                         | `shared-room`                | `{ peerId: string, nodeId: string }`
`characterjump` / `characterland`  | `xr-live-sim`                | `{ nodeId, position }` / `{ nodeId, fallSpeed }`
`agentstatechange` / `agentreach`  | `xr-live-sim`                | `{ nodeId, state, targetId }` / `{ agentId, targetId, position }`
`xrhit` / `xrdepleted`             | `xr-live-sim`                | `{ targetId, sourceId, amount, remaining, point }` / `{ targetId, group, scoreValue }`
`xrzoneenter` / `xrzoneexit`       | `xr-live-sim`                | `{ zoneId, nodeId, group }`
`xrspawn`                          | `xr-live-sim`                | `{ spawnerId, instanceId, index }`
`xrobjective`                      | `xr-live-sim`                | `{ nodeId, tag, type, amount, totalScore, remainingRequired, outOfOrder }`
`xrscorechange`                    | `xr-live-sim`                | `{ score, delta, attemptsLeft, timeRemaining }`
`xrscenarioend`                    | `xr-live-sim`                | `{ outcome: 'pass' \| 'fail' \| 'timeout', finalScore, elapsedSec }`
`xr-webmcp-capture`                | `xr-extras` (WebMCP)         | Fired when `capture_xr_view` captures a frame (`data-xr-webmcp-indicator="active"`).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 6. Simulation Plugins (`xr-live-sim`)

Load `xr-live-sim.min.js` (global `XRSim`, included in `xr-live-full.min.js`) or
import `xr-live/sim`. Systems step at a fixed 60 Hz (at most 5 steps per frame);
at most 128 spawned instances exist per scene.

Trait clamping (defaults in parentheses):

-   **`character`:** `speed` 0.1–20 (4), `runMultiplier` 1–4 (1.6),
    `jumpVelocity` 0–30 (5.5), `gravity` 0–50 (15), `radius` 0.05–5 (0.35),
    `height` ≥ 2 × radius (1.4), `cameraMode` (`third-person`), `cameraDistance`
    0.5–50 (3.5), `cameraHeight` −10–50 (1.8).
-   **`agent`:** `mode` (`wander`), `speed` 0.1–20 (2), `turnSpeed` 0.1–50 (6),
    `sightRadius` 0–100 (6), `stopDistance` 0.01–10 (0.6), `separationRadius`
    0–10 (0.8), up to 32 `waypoints`. `chase`, `flee`, and `follow` default
    `target` to `'user'`.
-   **`integrity`:** `max` 1–1e6 (100), `group` (`neutral`), `cooldownMs`
    0–10000 (250), `hideOnDepleted` (true), `scoreValue`, `contactAmount` (0).
-   **`zone`:** `shape` (`box`), `size` 0.01–1000 (1), `radius` (0.5), up to 16
    `watchGroups` (empty watches every tracked node).
-   **`spawner`:** `intervalSec` 0.05–3600 (3), `maxActive` 1–32 (8),
    `totalCount` (0 = unlimited), `spawnRadius` 0–100 (0).
-   **`objective`:** `type` (`pickup`), `amount` (10), `radius` 0.05–50 (0.65),
    `order` 0–1000 (0), `respawnSec` 0–3600 (0). Only pickups spin and bob by
    default.
-   **`audioCues`:** event-to-cue map, `pitchJitter` 0–0.5 (0.08), `volume` 0–1
    (1), `spatial` (true).

Host attributes: `character-controller`, `character-speed`, `character-jump`,
`touch-joystick`, `steering-agents`, `hit-zones`, `fire-rate`,
`projectile-speed`, `projectile-gravity`, `hit-amount`, `objectives`,
`scenario-timer`, `target-score`, `attempts`, `sim-hud`, `synth-audio`, and
`synth-volume`. `XRSim.resetSimScenario(element)` restarts the scenario.

SOURCE: skills/three-live-authoring/references/recipes.md
================================================================================

# Copy-Paste Recipes for `<three-live>` and `<xr-live>`

All 9 recipes below use features available in the repository today and work
without external build steps.

## Recipe 2: Spatial UI Card & Depth-Physics Ballpit (`<xr-live>`)

```html
<script type="module" src="/dist/xr-live-full.min.js"></script>

<xr-live
  allow-client-scripts
  xr-mode="ar"
  xr-depth="occlusion-physics"
  xr-hands="gestures"
  xr-simulator="living-room"
  sound-feedback
  camera-controls
  style="width: 100%; height: 600px; display: block;">

  <script type="text/three">
    const palette = [0x38bdf8, 0xf43f5e, 0x22c55e, 0xeab308, 0xa855f7];
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
      const ball = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.08, 24, 24),
        new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
          color: palette[i % palette.length],
          metalness: 0.2,
          roughness: 0.25
        })
      );
      ball.name = `ball-${i}`;
      ball.position.set((i % 4 - 1.5) * 0.22, 1.3 + Math.floor(i / 4) * 0.22, -1.1);
      ball.userData.xr = {
        grab: '1-hand',
        physics: 'dynamic',
        restitution: 0.78
      };
      scene.add(ball);
    }

    const light = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 2.0);
    light.position.set(1, 3, 2);
    scene.add(light);
  </script>

  <div slot="spatial" data-position="0.55 1.25 -1.1" data-xr-traits="grab billboard">
    <div style="padding: 16px; background: #0f172a; color: #f8fafc; border-radius: 14px; width: 220px;">
      <h4 style="margin: 0 0 8px;">Physics Controls</h4>
      <p style="margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 13px;">Grab spheres or bounce them off real-world surfaces.</p>
      <button onclick="document.querySelector('xr-live').transitionToVR({ durationMs: 400 })">
        Toggle VR Environment
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</xr-live>
```

## Recipe 6: Native Android (Kotlin) & iOS/visionOS (Swift) Integration

### Android (Google Filament + Jetpack XR SceneCore)

```kotlin
import com.google.threelive.ThreeLiveRuntimeSession
import com.google.threelive.XRLiveSceneCoreHelper
import com.google.threelive.filament.ThreeLiveFilament

// 1. Install the Filament renderer once at startup
ThreeLiveFilament.install()

// 2. Compile procedural Three.js and step XR traits / handles / particles natively
val session = ThreeLiveRuntimeSession.fromScript(scriptSource)
session.stepFrame(dtSeconds = 1f / 60f)

// 3. Or attach traits directly to an Android XR SceneCore entity from GLB bytes
XRLiveSceneCoreHelper.attachTraitsFromGlb(xrSession, rootEntity, glbByteBuffer)
```

### iOS & visionOS (Apple RealityKit)

```swift
import ThreeLiveCompiler
import RealityKit

@MainActor
func mountSpatialScene(script: String, in arView: ARView) async throws {
    let entity = try await RealityKitHelper.loadEntity(from: script)
    XRLiveRealityKit.installTraits(on: entity, in: arView)
}
```

## Recipe 10: Timed Training Drill with a Safety Zone (`xr-live-sim`)

Ordered task steps, a countdown, and an alarm zone around a robot cell. Load
`xr-live-sim.min.js` (or use `xr-live-full.min.js`). Taps complete steps in
order; out-of-order taps play an `error` cue.

```html
<script src="/dist/xr-live-sim.min.js"></script>

<xr-live
  id="drill"
  allow-client-scripts
  objectives
  scenario-timer="60"
  synth-audio
  style="width: 100%; height: 520px; display: block;">
  <script type="text/three">
    const mat = (color) => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color, roughness: 0.4 });

    // Ordered, required task steps (tap them in sequence)
    ['Step_1_Valve', 'Step_2_Filter', 'Step_3_Cap'].forEach((name, i) => {
      const part = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.2, 0.2, 0.2), mat(0x38bdf8));
      part.name = name;
      part.position.set(i * 0.4 - 0.4, 1.0, -1.0);
      part.userData.xr = {
        objective: { type: 'checkpoint', order: i + 1, required: true, amount: 10 },
        audioCues: { onObjective: 'confirm' }
      };
      scene.add(part);
    });

    // Robot cell: alarm while the AGV is inside
    const cell = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.2, 1, 1.2),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xef4444, transparent: true, opacity: 0.15 })
    );
    cell.name = 'Robot_Cell';
    cell.position.set(1.4, 0.5, -2);
    cell.userData.xr = {
      zone: { shape: 'box', size: [1.2, 1, 1.2], color: '#ef4444', watchGroups: ['agent'] },
      audioCues: { onZoneEnter: 'alarm' }
    };
    scene.add(cell);

    // AGV patrolling through the cell
    const agv = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.4, 0.2, 0.6), mat(0xf59e0b));
    agv.name = 'AGV';
    agv.position.set(-1.5, 0.1, -2);
    agv.userData.xr = {
      agent: { mode: 'patrol', speed: 0.8, waypoints: [[-1.5, 0.1, -2], [2.5, 0.1, -2]] }
    };
    scene.add(agv);

    scene.add(new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 2.2));
    scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.6));
  </script>
</xr-live>

<script>
  const drill = document.getElementById('drill');
  drill.addEventListener('xrobjective', (e) => {
    if (e.detail.outOfOrder) console.warn('Out of order:', e.detail.nodeId);
  });
  drill.addEventListener('xrzoneenter', (e) => {
    console.log(e.detail.nodeId, 'entered', e.detail.zoneId);
  });
  drill.addEventListener('xrscenarioend', (e) => {
    console.log('Outcome:', e.detail.outcome, 'in', e.detail.elapsedSec, 's');
  });
</script>
```

## Recipe 11: Procedural CAD Extrusion, CSG Booleans, 3D Text & GPU Instancing (`<three-live>`)

```html
<script type="module" src="/dist/three-live.min.js"></script>

<three-live
  allow-client-scripts
  camera-controls
  auto-rotate
  ar
  tone-mapping="aces"
  bloom="1.2"
  outline="#38bdf8 0.025"
  style="width: 100%; height: 520px; display: block;">
  <script type="text/three">
    const profile = new THREE.Shape();
    profile.absarc(0, 0, 0.55, 0, Math.PI * 2, false);
    const hole = new THREE.Path();
    hole.absarc(0, 0, 0.22, 0, Math.PI * 2, true);
    profile.holes.push(hole);

    const steel = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x94a3b8, metalness: 0.78, roughness: 0.24 });
    const rawFlange = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(profile, { depth: 0.16, bevelEnabled: true, bevelThickness: 0.02, bevelSize: 0.015 }),
      steel
    );
    rawFlange.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;

    const slotCutter = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.3, 0.14, 0.16), steel);
    slotCutter.position.set(0, 0.12, 0);
    const machined = THREE.CSG.subtract(rawFlange, slotCutter);
    machined.name = 'machined-flange';
    machined.userData.xr = { outline: { color: '#38bdf8', thickness: 0.02 } };
    scene.add(machined);

    const label = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TextGeometry('CAD R1', { size: 0.14, depth: 0.035, bevelEnabled: true }),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xf8fafc, emissive: 0x0ea5e9, emissiveIntensity: 0.45 })
    );
    label.position.set(-0.32, 0.28, 0);
    scene.add(label);

    const bolts = new THREE.InstancedMesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.035, 0.035, 0.22, 16),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xf59e0b, metalness: 0.9, roughness: 0.15 }),
      12
    );
    const m = new THREE.Matrix4();
    const p = new THREE.Vector3();
    const q = new THREE.Quaternion();
    const s = new THREE.Vector3(1, 1, 1);
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
      const a = (i / 12) * Math.PI * 2;
      p.set(Math.cos(a) * 0.39, 0.09, Math.sin(a) * 0.39);
      m.compose(p, q, s);
      bolts.setMatrixAt(i, m);
    }
    scene.add(bolts);

    scene.add(new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 2.4));
    scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.6));
  </script>
</three-live>
```


# Debugging, Sandboxing & CSP Guide (`<three-live>` & `<xr-live>`)

## 1. Why Nothing Renders (Top 4 Causes)

1. **Missing `allow-client-scripts` attribute:**
   - **Symptom:** `<three-live>` or `<xr-live>` with an inline `<script type="text/three">` stays blank and dispatches an `error` event with `CLIENT_SCRIPTS_DISABLED_ERROR`.
   - **Fix:** Add `allow-client-scripts` to the element (`<three-live allow-client-scripts ...>`) or set `ThreeLiveElement.allowClientScripts = true` before connecting.
2. **Bundler moved the Worker engine asset (`sandboxEngineSrc`):**
   - **Symptom:** When bundling with Vite, Webpack, or Rollup instead of loading `/dist/three-live.min.js` via `<script>`, the sandbox Worker cannot auto-detect the IIFE bundle URL and fails closed.
   - **Fix:** Explicitly point `ThreeLiveElement.sandboxEngineSrc` at the IIFE `.min.js` bundle:
     
     ```js
     import { ThreeLiveElement } from 'three-live';
     ThreeLiveElement.sandboxEngineSrc =
       new URL('three-live/dist/three-live.min.js', import.meta.url).href;
     ```
3. **Strict Host CSP (`require-trusted-types-for 'script'` or blocked `blob:` Workers):**
   - **Symptom:** The host page's Content Security Policy blocks Worker creation or script evaluation.
   - **Fix:** Set `sandbox="iframe"` on the element and configure `ThreeLiveElement.sandboxIframeSrc` to point at `three-live-sandbox.html`, which runs inside an opaque-origin `<iframe sandbox="allow-scripts">`.
4. **Calling `new THREE.GLTFLoader()` or `fetch()` inside `<script type="text/three">`:**
   - **Symptom:** External model does not appear because `fetch` and `XMLHttpRequest` are permanently revoked inside the sandbox Worker.
   - **Fix:** Use `<three-live src="/path/to/model.glb">` or `<xr-anchor src="/path/to/model.glb">`.

## 3. Enforced Sandbox Quotas

Every procedural compilation (`toCanvas3D()`, `toGLB()`, `toUSDZ()`) runs `SceneQuotaValidator` with these defaults:

- **Max Script Size:** `1,048,576` bytes (`1 MiB`)
- **Max Meshes:** `1,000`
- **Max Vertices:** `100,000`
- **Max Indices:** `300,000`
- **Max Textures:** `16` (max dimension `2048×2048`)
- **Execution Watchdog:** `3,000 ms` wall-clock timeout (`250 ms` CPU ceiling inside Rust Boa compiler)
- **Max Concurrent Sandbox Workers:** `32`

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 4. Network CSP & Plugin Security Quotas (`gemini-live`, `shared-room`, `persistent-anchors`)

-   **Host `connect-src` for Live Relays:** The procedural
    `<script type="text/three">` Worker always runs with network access revoked
    (`connect-src 'none'`). Host-level plugins (`connectGeminiLive()` and
    `shared-room="wss://..."`) connect from the main thread and enforce `wss://`
    (or loopback `ws://localhost` / `ws://127.0.0.1` / `ws://[::1]`). If your
    page serves a strict Content Security Policy and uses remote WebSocket
    relays, allow your relay origin in `connect-src` (e.g.
    `connect-src 'self' wss://your-relay.example.com`). Same-origin
    `shared-room="room-id"` uses `BroadcastChannel` and needs no `connect-src`
    allowance.
-   **Persistence & Co-Presence Caps:**
    -   `persistent-anchors`: `MAX_PERSISTED_NODES = 128`,
        `MAX_HASH_BYTES = 8192` (`#xr-state` tokens larger than `8 KB` or
        containing prototype-pollution keys are rejected).
    -   `shared-room`: `MAX_PEERS = 16`, `MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES = 16384` (`16 KB`),
        `MAX_REMOTE_STROKES = 64`, `POSE_TICK_INTERVAL_MS = 50` (`20 Hz`),
        `SOFT_LOCK_TTL_MS = 2000`.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 5. Closed-Loop CLI Diagnostics (`TL100–TL402`), Headless Contact Sheets & Scenario Simulation

Use `three-live-cli` to verify `.js`, `.html`, and `.glb` scenes without a
browser:

```bash
# 1. Validate syntax, schema, HTML attributes, and 3D spatial layout
three-live-cli validate scene.js --json

# 2. Render a 2x2 quad contact sheet (Camera, Front, Right, Top) with 1m grid & AABB labels
three-live-cli render scene.js -o preview.png --view=quad --grid --annotations

# 3. Render a 4-frame temporal filmstrip or animated GIF with KHR_interactivity onSelect trigger
three-live-cli render scene.js -o anim.png --frames=4 --duration=2.0 --trigger-select=crystal

# 4. Run a 60Hz deterministic scenario simulation
three-live-cli sim scene.js --duration=5.0 \
  --actions='[{"at":0.2,"type":"select","target":"crystal"},{"at":0.5,"type":"moveCharacter","direction":[0,0,-1],"duration":1.5}]' \
  --json
```

### Diagnostic Code Table (`TL100–TL402`)

Code    | Severity  | Condition                                                          | Actionable Fix
:------ | :-------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------- | :-------------
`TL100` | `error`   | Syntax error, runtime exception, or quota exceeded                 | Check `line`/`column` in JSON output and fix JS syntax or reduce vertex/mesh count.
`TL101` | `warning` | `ShaderMaterial` / `RawShaderMaterial` fallback                    | Replace with `THREE.MeshStandardMaterial` or `THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial`.
`TL102` | `warning` | Polyhedron/Tube geometry fallback                                  | Use `SphereGeometry`, `CylinderGeometry`, `ExtrudeGeometry`, `LatheGeometry`, or `THREE.CSG`.
`TL103` | `warning` | `THREE.GLTFLoader` / `TextureLoader` / `fetch`                     | Load external `.glb` via `<three-live src="model.glb">` or `<xr-anchor src="model.glb">`.
`TL104` | `info`    | `requestAnimationFrame` in static export                           | Use `userData.xr.orbit` or `userData.interactivity` so motion survives `.glb`/`.usdz` export.
`TL105` | `warning` | Unknown `THREE.*` constructor/method                               | Remove unsupported Three.js helper call.
`TL201` | `warning` | Unknown `userData.xr` or `userData.interactivity` key              | Apply the Levenshtein suggestion in `suggestion` (e.g. `grabbable` -> `grab`).
`TL202` | `warning` | Out-of-range numeric trait clamped                                 | Keep `gaze.dwellMs` in `[200, 10000]`, `bloom.strength` in `[0, 5]`, `outline.thickness` in `[0.002, 0.25]`.
`TL203` | `error`   | Unsafe media/live/room URL or anchor ID                            | Use `https://` (or clean relative paths) for media, `wss://` for relays, and alphanumeric anchor IDs.
`TL204` | `error`   | Broken target node reference                                       | Ensure `orbit.target`, `ik.*`, `spawner.template`, and `interactivity.*.target` match an existing `mesh.name`.
`TL205` | `warning` | Unnamed interactive/spatial mesh                                   | Set a unique `mesh.name = "..."` before attaching `userData.xr` or `userData.interactivity`.
`TL301` | `error`   | Empty scene (`meshCount == 0`)                                     | Call `scene.add(mesh)` with at least one non-empty geometry.
`TL302` | `warning` | Camera inside mesh AABB                                            | Move camera outside `summary.worldBounds` or shrink the enclosing mesh.
`TL303` | `warning` | Mesh outside camera frustum or extreme framing                     | Reposition the mesh or adjust camera `position` / `lookAt` so `screenCoveragePct` is between `5%` and `85%`.
`TL304` | `warning` | Extreme scene scale (`< 0.01 m` or `> 200 m`)                      | Author dimensions in meters (`1 unit = 1 meter`); scale millimeter meshes by `0.001`.
`TL305` | `warning` | Unlit metallic PBR material                                        | Add a `DirectionalLight` / `AmbientLight` or set `environment` on `<three-live>`.
`TL306` | `warning` | Co-located sibling meshes (`> 80%` overlap)                        | Offset sibling positions or use `THREE.CSG.subtract(a, b)` for boolean cutouts.
`TL307` | `info`    | Floating or buried scene / character                               | Align `min.y` to `0.0` (`mesh.position.y = height / 2`) so AR/VR placement sits on the floor.
`TL401` | `error`   | Inline `<script type="text/three">` without `allow-client-scripts` | Add `allow-client-scripts` to `<three-live>` or `<xr-live>`.
`TL402` | `warning` | `<xr-live>` feature used on `<three-live>`                         | Upgrade the tag from `<three-live>` to `<xr-live>` and load `xr-live.min.js`.

================================================================================
SOURCE: docs/three-live.md
================================================================================

# `<three-live>` Reference Guide

`<three-live>` is a lightweight WebGL2 3D viewer, procedural Three.js JIT
compiler, and `<model-viewer>` drop-in replacement with universal Augmented
Reality handoff (iOS Quick Look, Android Scene Viewer, and WebXR).

For interactive 6DoF WebXR spatial computing, declarative spatial traits
(`grab`, `scale`, `billboard`, `anchor`), spatial HTML cards (`<div
slot="spatial">`), depth/physics, and 25-joint hand tracking, see
**[`docs/xr-live.md`](xr-live.md)**. See **[`README.md`](../README.md)** for JS
bundles and entry points.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Quickstart

```html
<script type="module" src="/dist/three-live.min.js"></script>

<three-live
  src="/models/chair.glb"
  poster="/images/chair_poster.webp"
  camera-controls
  camera-orbit="30deg 20deg 3m"
  selected-mesh="cushion"
  ar
  ar-modes="quick-look scene-viewer webxr"
  auto-rotate
  style="width: 100%; height: 500px; display: block;">
</three-live>

<script>
  const viewer = document.querySelector('three-live');

  // Listen for mesh part selection
  viewer.addEventListener('meshclick', (e) => {
    console.log('Selected part:', e.detail.meshName);
  });

  // Reset camera view
  viewer.resetCamera();
</script>
```

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Observed Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Bundle | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `src` | `string` | `three-live-viewer`+ | URL or path to binary `.glb` model. |
| `ios-src` | `string` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Optional URL or path to Apple `.usdz` model for iOS Quick Look (auto-transcoded from GLB if omitted). |
| `poster` | `string` | `three-live-viewer`+ | URL to a placeholder image shown before 3D rendering initializes. |
| `scale` | `string` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Uniform or per-axis scale multiplier `"x y z"` (e.g. `"2 2 2"`). |
| `camera-orbit` | `string` (str/JSON) | `three-live-viewer`+ | Initial camera orbit angles and distance (`"45deg 20deg 3m"` or `{"theta": 0.8, "phi": 0.35, "zoom": 3}`). |
| `camera-target` | `string` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Orbit center coordinate `"x y z"` (e.g. `"0m 1.5m 0m"`, defaults to model bounding center). |
| `min-camera-orbit` | `string` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Lower bounds for camera orbit `"theta phi radius"` (e.g. `"-45deg 0deg 1m"` or `"auto 0deg auto"`). |
| `max-camera-orbit` | `string` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Upper bounds for camera orbit (e.g. `"auto 90deg auto"` prevents orbiting beneath the ground plane). |
| `field-of-view` | `string` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Vertical field of view angle (e.g. `"45deg"`, clamps between `10deg` and `90deg`). |
| `selected-mesh` | `string` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Name of the sub-mesh to highlight. |
| `camera-controls` | `boolean` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Enables interactive orbit/pan/zoom camera controls (disabled by default unless `camera-controls` is present, matching `<model-viewer>`). |
| `ar` | `boolean` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Enables the augmented reality launcher button. |
| `ar-modes` | `string` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Space-delimited AR modes: `quick-look`, `scene-viewer`, `webxr`. |
| `ar-scale` | `string` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Controls whether the model can be scaled in AR: `"auto"` (default) or `"fixed"`. |
| `ar-placement` | `string` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Controls AR surface placement mode: `"floor"` (default) or `"wall"`. |
| `script-src` | `string` | `three-live`+ | URL or path to a server-generated procedural Three.js scene script. |
| `sandbox` | `string` | `three-live`+ | Mandatory sandbox mode (`"worker"` or `"iframe"`). Default: `"worker"`. |
| `allow-client-scripts` | `boolean` | `three-live`+ | Explicit opt-in allowing client-modified script strings via `executeScript()` or inline `<script>`. |
| `exposure` | `number` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Linear exposure applied to all lighting before tone mapping, like model-viewer (default: `1.0`). |
| `environment-image` | `string` | `three-live-studio` | Equirectangular `.hdr`/`.pic` radiance map or LDR environment image for ambient reflections and SH irradiance. |
| `skybox-image` | `string` | `three-live-studio` | Visible background equirectangular skybox image URL rendered behind the 3D scene. |
| `shadow-intensity` | `number` | `three-live`+ | Ground contact shadow opacity from `0.0` (off) to `1.0` (default: `0.7`). |
| `shadow-softness` | `number` | `three-live`+ | Radial Gaussian blur falloff of contact shadow from `0.0` (hard) to `1.0` (soft). |
| `tone-mapping` | `string` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Tone mapping mode: `"neutral"` (default, Khronos PBR Neutral), `"aces"` (ACES Filmic), `"agx"` (AgX Filmic), `"reinhard"`, or `"none"`. |
| `variant-name` | `string` | `three-live-studio` | Active `KHR_materials_variants` product material variant name (e.g. `"Midnight Black"`). Also readable/writable via `viewer.variantName` and `viewer.availableVariants`. |
| `bloom` | `boolean \| string` | `three-live-studio` | Enables HDR emissive bloom (`bloom`, `bloom="1.4"`, or `bloom="strength:1.2 threshold:0.75 radius:0.5"`). |
| `outline` | `boolean \| string` | `three-live-studio` | Enables silhouette outlines on `selected-mesh`, nodes with `userData.xr.outline`, or all foreground meshes (`outline`, `outline="#38bdf8"`, or `outline="#38bdf8 0.025"`). |
| `autoplay` | `boolean` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Automatically starts keyframe animation playback on model load. |
| `animation-name` | `string` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Name of specific glTF animation clip to play (defaults to first clip). |
| `auto-rotate` | `boolean` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Automatically rotates the camera around the model. |
| `renderer` | `"auto" \| "webgpu" \| "webgl2"` | `three-live-webgpu` | Renderer preference when `three-live-webgpu` is loaded (`"auto"` default accelerates compatible desktop/inline scenes via WebGPU `GPURenderBundle` and falls back to WebGL2 automatically). |

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## `<model-viewer>` Drop-in Imperative API

`<three-live>` provides full drop-in compatibility for `<model-viewer>`
JavaScript configurators, hotspot managers, and AR launchers:

-   **Camera & Screenshot:** `viewer.getCameraOrbit()`,
    `viewer.getCameraTarget()`, `viewer.getFieldOfView()`,
    `viewer.jumpCameraToGoal()`, `viewer.toDataURL()`, `await viewer.toBlob()`
-   **AR Status & Activation:** `viewer.canActivateAR` (boolean getter), `await
    viewer.activateAR()`
-   **Surface Raycasting:** `viewer.positionAndNormalFromPoint(pixelX, pixelY)`
    returns `{ position: { x, y, z, toString() }, normal: { x, y, z, toString()
    } } | null`
-   **Live Material Editing & `KHR_materials_variants`
    (`viewer.model.materials`, `viewer.availableVariants`,
    `viewer.variantName`):**

    ```js
    // Switch a glTF KHR_materials_variants colorway (or USDZ VariantSet)
    console.log(viewer.availableVariants); // ['Midnight Black', 'Titanium Silver']
    viewer.variantName = 'Titanium Silver';

    // Or edit PBR material factors directly
    const mat = viewer.model.getMaterialByName('Leather') || viewer.model.materials[0];
    mat.pbrMetallicRoughness.setBaseColorFactor([0.8, 0.2, 0.1, 1.0]);
    mat.pbrMetallicRoughness.setRoughnessFactor(0.35);
    ```

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## DOM Events

| Event | Detail Payload | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `load` | `{ model: GLBData }` | Fired when the 3D model or procedural scene finishes loading. |
| `error` | `{ error: Error }` | Fired if model loading or script execution fails. |
| `camera-change` | `{ theta, phi, distance }` | Fired whenever the camera orbit changes. |
| `ar-status` | `{ status: 'session-started' \| 'not-presenting' \| 'failed', error? }` | Fired when AR session status transitions (`<model-viewer>` standard). |
| `meshclick` | `{ meshName, hitPoint, normal, distance }` | Fired when a user clicks or taps a sub-mesh. |

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Custom AR Button Overlay (`slot="ar-button"` / `activateAR()`)

Provide a child element with `slot="ar-button"` to replace the default AR button
overlay with your own custom styled button. `<three-live>` automatically hides
its built-in button, manages visibility when `ar` is enabled, and triggers
`activateAR()` on click:

```html
<three-live src="/models/chair.glb" camera-controls ar style="width: 100%; height: 500px;">
  <button slot="ar-button" class="custom-ar-btn">
    ✨ View in Your Space
  </button>
</three-live>
```

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Visual Extensions & Plugins

### 3D Hotspots & Annotations (`three-live/studio`)

Import `three-live/studio` (or use `three-live-full.min.js`) to attach
interactive HTML buttons or callouts pinned to 3D surface coordinates. Hotspots
automatically orbit with the camera and support surface normal occlusion
culling:

```html
<script type="module" src="/dist/three-live-full.min.js"></script>

<three-live src="/models/astronaut.glb" camera-controls camera-target="0 1.2 0" style="width: 100%; height: 500px; display: block;">
  <button slot="hotspot-visor" data-position="0 1.5 0.3" data-normal="0 0 1" class="hotspot">
    Gold-coated Visor
  </button>
  <div slot="hotspot-pack" data-position="0 1.3 -0.4" data-normal="0 0 -1" class="hotspot">
    Life Support Unit
  </div>
</three-live>
```

Update a hotspot dynamically at runtime using `viewer.updateHotspot({ name,
position, normal })`.

### PBR Rendering, Tone Mapping, Post-Processing & Lighting Extensions

-   **Core WebGL2 PBR (`three-live-viewer`+):**
    -   **Screen-Space Derivative Normal Maps:** Perturbs normals via GLSL
        `dFdx`/`dFdy` without requiring glTF vertex tangents.
    -   **5 Filmic & Commerce Tone Mapping Modes (`tone-mapping`):** Supports
        `"neutral"` (default Khronos PBR Neutral for accurate e-commerce
        colors), `"aces"` (Narkowicz ACES Filmic), `"agx"` (Sobotka AgX Filmic
        with smooth highlight chroma desaturation), `"reinhard"`, and `"none"`.
    -   **GPU Instancing (`EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing` / `THREE.InstancedMesh`):**
        Renders up to `MAX_INSTANCE_COUNT = 10,000` instances per mesh with
        per-instance `MAT4` transforms and optional per-instance `COLOR_0` tints
        (one `drawElementsInstanced` call per primitive, with per-instance
        vertex attributes), exporting to glTF `EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing` and USDZ
        `PointInstancer`.
-   **HDR Emissive Bloom & Silhouette Outlines (`three-live/studio` /
    `postprocessingPlugin`):**
    -   **Bloom (`bloom` attribute or `mesh.userData.xr.bloom`):** Dual-Kawase
        MIP-chain HDR bloom and soft emissive halo generation
        (`{ strength: 1.2, threshold: 0.8, radius: 0.5 }`).
    -   **Selection & Highlight Outlines (`outline` attribute or
        `mesh.userData.xr.outline`):** Inverted-hull and screen-space Sobel
        silhouette outlines (`{ color: '#38bdf8', thickness: 0.03 }`),
        automatically highlighting `selected-mesh` or outlined nodes.
-   **Distance-Based Level of Detail (`three-live/studio` / `lodPlugin`):**
    -   **`THREE.LOD` & `mesh.userData.xr.lod`:** Author multi-tier LOD groups
        via `const lod = new THREE.LOD(); lod.addLevel(highMesh, 0);
        lod.addLevel(lowMesh, 8);` or attach automatic vertex-clustering
        decimation via `mesh.userData.xr = { lod: { distances: [0, 5, 12],
        ratios: [1.0, 0.4, 0.15], cullDistance: 30, hysteresis: 0.05 } }`.
        Exports to glTF `MSFT_lod` + `KHR_node_visibility` and evaluates
        per-frame across Web, Android, and iOS.
-   **PBR Next Materials, HDRI & Contact Shadows (`three-live/studio`):**
    -   **glTF PBR Next Extensions:** Shader support for Clearcoat
        (`KHR_materials_clearcoat`), Transmission
        (`KHR_materials_transmission`), Dispersion (`KHR_materials_dispersion`),
        Volume Attenuation (`KHR_materials_volume`), Iridescence
        (`KHR_materials_iridescence`), and Sheen (`KHR_materials_sheen`).
    -   **HDRI Radiance Maps & Spherical Harmonics:** Set
        `environment-image="/env/studio.hdr"` to parse Radiance `.hdr` RGBE
        textures, prefilter GGX specular mipmaps, and project 9-coefficient
        Spherical Harmonics diffuse irradiance.
    -   **Analytical Ground Contact Shadows:** Set `shadow-intensity="0.7"` and
        `shadow-softness="0.5"` for soft ground ambient occlusion without shadow
        map pass overhead.

### Animations: Rigid-Body TRS, Skeletal/Morph & Inverse Kinematics (IK)

-   **Rigid-Body Keyframe Animations (`three-live-viewer`+):** Node translation,
    rotation, and scale (`TRS`) keyframe tracks are built into all bundles
    (`el.availableAnimations`, `el.play()`, `el.pause()`).
-   **GPU Skeletal Skinning, Morph Targets & Cross-Fading
    (`three-live/animation`):** Import `three-live/animation` (or use
    `three-live-full.min.js`) to enable 64-joint GPU vertex skinning
    (`JOINTS_0`/`WEIGHTS_0`), morph target blending (`weights`), and smooth clip
    cross-fading (`el.crossFadeTo('Walk', 0.3)`).
-   **Analytical 2-Bone & FABRIK Inverse Kinematics (`ikPlugin` /
    `userData.xr.ik` / `THREE.IKSolver`):** Attach `mesh.userData.xr.ik = {
    root: 'Shoulder', mid: 'Forearm', effector: 'Wrist', target: 'TargetNode',
    pole: 'ElbowPole', solver: 'two-bone' | 'fabrik', iterations: 10 }` to solve
    robotic arms, mechanical linkages, and character limbs at runtime across
    Web, Android, and iOS, or call `THREE.IKSolver.solveTwoBone(...)` /
    `THREE.IKSolver.solveFABRIK(...)` directly inside
    `<script type="text/three">`.

### Declarative `KHR_interactivity` Behavior Graphs (`userData.interactivity`)

Inside `<script type="text/three">`, any `THREE.Mesh` or `THREE.Group` can
attach declarative `userData.interactivity` triggers (`onSelect`, `onHoverIn`,
`onHoverOut`, `onStart`, `onReceive`) that compile into standard Khronos
